rules.statement: The entirety of Rasammah's vested interest in the tediatetam property passed to her heirs upon her death, as the new sections 19 and 20 have no application.
rules.supporting_quote: "Accordingly, the entirety of Rasammah's vested interest in the tediatetam property (i.e., a 7/36 share) passed to the appellants as her heirs."
